text:
maria: Incoming pen test PDF uploaded to the evidence bucket. P1/P2 need owners by EOD tomorrow. Please add quick remediation notes in the triage sheet.

jason: OK. I'll scan infra for `kms:` references and list affected keys. Posting results to the sheet.

sam: Made a lightweight spreadsheet: id, sev, svc, owner, blocker, eta, evidence. Link: https://tiny.redwood/pt-triage-2. Add rows as you claim owners.

lee: Two P1s reference a shared analytics key with broad decrypt permissions. Short-term: restrict key policy to analytics role ARN and deny decrypt outside VPC endpoints. Longer-term: envelope encryption per dataset.

jason: Found key resource at `infra/kms/analytics_key.tf`. I'll open a PR to tighten the policy and add `aws:SourceVpc` condition. Will include plan to rotate key with canary.

maria: Good. Make sure rotation plan includes secret update in vault and a canary DAG test. Notify @data-team in the sheet.

security-bot: Reminder: after fixes, run `scripts/evidence/collect --start 2024-11-01 --end 2024-11-07 --out pt-bundle.tar.gz` and produce `pt-bundle.tar.gz.sha256`. Use readroom upload pattern.

jason: Quick CI note: include `make test-kms-policy` that lints policy and simulates a decrypt from non-VPC IP to ensure deny triggers. CI should block on failures.

sam: For assessor access, propose ephemeral role with 1h TTL and require `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent` and `RequestTag/assessor=true`. That makes audit filtering easier.

lee: Also add CloudTrail and KMS CloudWatch export tasks scoped to the retest window. Assessors want evidence 24h prior. We'll freeze infra 2h before slot.

oncall: I'll reserve two retest slots: Wed 08:00-12:00 UTC and Sat 20:00-24:00 UTC. Creating temporary channel for the window and will stand up the staging bridge.

maria: Ops checklist for P1/P2 fixes: owner + jira, PR w/ rollback plan, CI tests, key policy changes, ephemeral assessor role, evidence export scheduled, readroom presigned URLs + sha, legal/reg review if customer keys touched.

jason: I'll tag any PRs with `pt:security-fix` and include the cloudtrail export command in PR notes. Example: `aws cloudtrail create-export-task --trail-name prod --start-time 2024-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-07T00:00:00Z --s3-bucket redwood-pt-evidence`.

sam: I'll mark rows in the sheet for legal review where the changes affect customer-key flows.

security-bot: Meeting scheduled: "PT remediation huddle" 2024-11-02T16:00Z. Attendees: maria, jason, sam, lee, oncall.

maria: Thanks everyone. If you take an owner, comment in the sheet and ping `@maria`. We'll run a 15m sitrep the morning after EOD to confirm PRs and blockers. :white_check_mark:
